cc:Work.dc:title: Row split: B=100 RMSE comparison
cc:Work.dc:description: Row split; B=100 matched evaluation; arithmetic means across 5 fixed seeds; V1/V2 test RMSE in mL; zero-shot uses no target training labels; paper_style_current_v2 is project implementation, not original-paper results. Independent linear zero-based y axes: 8g 0–25, 25g 0–80, 40g 0–150 mL. Source main: 42ab12600a353bba4a063ef5d1b623ee2f7b976a.
